title: Venus Meaning
overview: Venus describes attraction, affection, pleasure, beauty, social ease, values, money, taste, and the way a person gives and receives sweetness. It shows what feels desirable, what feels worth protecting, and how harmony is created or avoided.
cycle: Venus usually spends about three to five weeks in a sign, though retrograde cycles can extend the stay. Its sign describes love style, values, and aesthetic preference; its house shows where connection, pleasure, and value-seeking become most visible.

signs.body: Venus in Aries loves directly, boldly, and with appetite for pursuit. This placement needs aliveness, honesty, and the freedom to want what it wants without over-explaining desire.
Venus in Taurus loves through steadiness, touch, loyalty, pleasure, and material care. This placement needs consistency and a love that can be felt in the body.
Venus in Gemini loves through conversation, curiosity, wit, and mental connection. This placement needs variety, laughter, and a partner who keeps the mind awake.
Venus in Cancer loves protectively, tenderly, and through emotional memory. This placement needs trust, care, and a bond that feels like a safe place to land.
Venus in Leo loves warmly, generously, creatively, and with a need for visible affection. This placement needs admiration, play, loyalty, and romance with heart.
Venus in Virgo loves through service, attention, repair, and thoughtful detail. This placement needs sincerity and may show devotion by noticing what would make life easier.
Venus in Libra loves through reciprocity, beauty, fairness, and partnership. This placement needs mutuality and can create harmony without losing the ability to choose.
Venus in Scorpio loves intensely, privately, and with a need for emotional truth. This placement needs trust, depth, and relationships that can hold real vulnerability.
Venus in Sagittarius loves through honesty, adventure, humor, and shared meaning. This placement needs freedom and a bond that makes life feel wider.
Venus in Capricorn loves seriously, loyally, and through commitment that proves itself over time. This placement needs reliability, maturity, and shared long-term values.
Venus in Aquarius loves through friendship, ideals, freedom, and respect for difference. This placement needs space inside connection and a bond that can hold individuality.
Venus in Pisces loves compassionately, imaginatively, and with great emotional openness. This placement needs tenderness, inspiration, and boundaries that keep devotion from becoming self-loss.
